chunk_list: LUMEN RIGHTS AND REUSE PROTOCOL V1.0 Purpose This protocol defines how to decide whether LUMEN metadata, thumbnails, images, transcriptions, and digital objects may be used internally, displayed in the demonstrator, transferred, or published. Classification Modes are open, internal, restricted, and pending. Open permits the use stated by the licence. Internal limits use to the approved team and purpose. Restricted requires additional controls. Pending prevents publication until a decision is received. Matrix Every object records its source, rights holder, right type, conditions, credit, permitted files, maximum resolution, territories, period, and evidence. Rights in the original and digital reproduction are assessed separately. Demonstrator An object may be displayed in full, as a thumbnail, as metadata only, or excluded. Existence of a file does not imply permission. The interface displays conditions and credit where relevant. Review

Mateo Ruiz Serra prepares the classification. Eva Calderón Gil validates archival context. Clara Ibáñez Soto reviews the licence and transfer. Uncertain cases remain pending. Control 1 Review uses the most specific available contractual or legal source. An unsupported internal note does not replace a licence. Where conditions change, a new version is created and the earlier one retained to explain historical uses. Control 2 The public package is generated from a positive list of approved objects. It does not begin with every file and exclude later. An automated check compares the list, manifest, and resulting files. Control 3 Withdrawals have an identifier, reason, date, and owner. The object stops being displayed, while its record may retain metadata where authorized. Caches and thumbnails are deleted, and deletion is verified.
